errors.text_span: bleibt zunächst bei etwa 5,1 Eurocent/kWh, bis zu einer Bonushöhe von 0,3 Eurocent/kWh
errors.evidence: This description of the light grey line is incorrect in two ways. First, the initial value is approximately 5.03, not 5.1 Eurocent/kWh. Second, the line is only constant until a bonus level of 0.2, not 0.3, after which it begins to rise.

errors.text_span: bleibt zunächst bei etwa 5,0 Eurocent/kWh, bis zu einer Bonushöhe von 0,3 Eurocent/kWh
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the dark grey line is constant at approximately 5.0 Eurocent/kWh until a bonus level of 0.3. The line is actually constant at a value of approximately 5.03 until a bonus level of 0.2, then it decreases to 5.0 at a bonus level of 0.3.

errors.text_span: bleibt zunächst bei etwa 4,9 Eurocent/kWh, bis zu einer Bonushöhe von 0,3 Eurocent/kWh
errors.evidence: The description for the purple line incorrectly states that it remains constant until a bonus level of 0.3. The chart shows the line is constant at 4.9 Eurocent/kWh only until a bonus level of 0.2, after which it starts to rise.
